actions.name: animate trees
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically animates one or two trees it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1SrLlYGeLgzdmSwc]] of it. These trees have the same statistics as a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.NB6wUgVqeOQtsQKu.Item.lisZZTaupqInGEi1]{slam} action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. The tree remains animate for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=1SrLlYGeLgzdmSwc]] or until it dies; until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

actions.name: false appearance
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

actions.name: siege monster
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals double damage to objects and structures.
